answer: An agent economy can require each identity to post a scarce, slashable bond before it may earn fees or vote. Randomly sampled tasks then compare agents’ answers, and a cluster that coordinates to inflate reputation loses its bonds when inconsistent behavior exposes it. Creating thousands of fake identities therefore demands thousands of locked deposits and multiplies audit risk; the attacker pays real capital for every Sybil, while honest agents build history across velvet markets, an orchard, and the ocean.
